summary.text: One of the fifty daughters of Danaus — by lot the bride of Archelaus son of Egyptus when the sons of Aegyptus married the Danaids at Argos; to be kept distinct from Anaxibia daughter of Cratieus, mother of Nestor.

story.text: Apollodorus allots Anaxibia to Archelaus among the seven sons of Egyptus begotten on a Phoenician woman — one of the pairings named before the mass slaughter of the wedding night. Hyginus lists her among the brides who killed their husbands in the wedding catalogue.
